component.name: SWMMVis
component.summary: SWMM model setup, analysis, and visualization tool

description.p: SWMMVis is an open-source graphical interface for the Open-Source Storm Water Management Model (SWMM). It supports model setup, simulation, and visualization of results including 1D drainage networks and 2D surface routing.
Features include a GIS-capable map canvas, layer management, attribute editing, mesh generation for 2D surface routing, time-series plotting, and integration with the OpenSWMM engine.
Alpha 3 release of the OpenSWMM GUI.
Initial alpha release of the OpenSWMM GUI.
